body:
I happend to know someone who has a tendency of getting rare mind expanding substances and bought a vile for 80 dollars. It wasn't my first time so I knew the microwave was the best way to create a snortable powder. I luckily had a small syringe which I had used for injecting spores, but thats another story! So I took about 3cc's of liquid and put them on a black plate as it made it easier to see the final product. I microwaved on high until I heard popping for about 15 seconds then I stopped it. It was perfect! Barely wet yet dry enough to snort. I used a razor blade to stir and mix the half powder half dry solution which made the drying process much simpler, especially since the plate was still warm. I proceeded to form lines with the powder. very small yet enough to fell something, simply to test the potency and taste. After my first two key bumps I felt like I had been hit with a velvet shovel. I laid back and exhaled the as if I were smoking. It felt great! I find this is a drug best saved for special occasions which involve doing nothing to physical!
Be safe and have fun.
